Provider lifecycle paths, Windows-specific unit tests, offline toolkit wheel build and integrity, provider adoption, managed runtime, MCP initialization, project resolution, and fail-closed unregistered-project behavior passed on Windows AMD64. This promotes provider lifecycle support only; named Windows IDE/AI hosts remain independently gated. See docs/evidence/v1.20.0-windows-amd64.json.
